content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Physical Laboratory, popularly known as CSIR NPL, located in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in CSIR NPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 41 temporary vacancies advertised under advertisement number Rectt./04/2026 for various research and technical positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to report directly to the venue with the completed application form and documents.

faq.question: Q4. What are the dates for the walk-in interviews?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on 21 October 2026 for Post Code 1.0 to 17.0 and on 22 October 2026 for Post Code 18.0 to 36.0.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Please note that candidates will not be entertained after 10:00 AM under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Auditorium, CSIR-NPL, Dr. K. S. Krishnan Marg, New Delhi - 110012.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Qualifications range from Diploma, B.Sc., M.Sc., B.Tech, M.Tech to Ph.D. in relevant science and engineering disciplines depending on the specific post code.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 58,000/- plus admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA) depending upon the post.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interviews of CSIR NPL project positions.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for multiple posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for a maximum of 02 posts by submitting separate application forms for each post they wish to attend.
